resolved_findings.resolution: Exact A/B text at exact fixture node ID, independently derived expected target, unique owned-node set and state are mandatory; stale or missing DOM invalidates.

Commit-phase rendered-view layout effect, observer armed before dispatch, fresh generation and identity continuity, production React/Vite mode, HMR off and actual StrictMode configuration are explicit. No flushSync, forced layout or DOM queries in timed callbacks.
Cold-start series required separately; NOT_CONDUCTED leaves cold-start and overall performance gate open. Worker-startup treatment explicit.

assessment: Revised plan faithfully retains actual AllowApp, controller, checker, full forest and advisory behavior while requiring 500 rendered fixture nodes, 100 warmups and 1000 measured edits. Two post-commit callbacks bound the declared paint-opportunity interval; strict unrounded warm p95 <50ms is separately classified. Temporary static assets require exact restoration. Gameplan approval does not establish execution, latency, server diagnostics, physical paint, accessibility or manual AT.
lean_limit: Abstract supplied-validity/count/order/threshold model only; does not derive percentile or prove runtime correspondence.
validation: Read both revised inputs and verified exact SHA-256 hashes. No benchmark executed, no Lean compilation performed, no candidate or production files edited.
